'''Landing pad X-13''', also known as '''berth X-13''', was a [[Hangar/Legends|landing pad]] at [[Makem Te spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] in operation during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge" /> [[New Ambition|''Shadowfire'']], a [[Suwantek Systems|Suwantek]] [[TL-1200 transport]] owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]] was docked in the bay. Popara's intermediary [[Vago Gejalli Thokka]] handed over the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]]<ref name="Tempest Feud">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref> to the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] for an assignment on the planet [[Endregaad]]. The trio ventured to landing pad X-13 to inspect the vessel and take onboard a cargo of [[medicinal spice]].<ref name="Scourge" /> Before the vessel departed, Popara's son Zonnos visited the bay and offered the services of his [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] servant [[Gabbera]] as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the mission.<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> Zuma, Irana and Be'ray subsequently departed the bay aboard the transport and flew to Endregaad.<ref name="Scourge" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
A landing pad named landing bay X14 appeared in the [[2002]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Tempest Feud]]'', by [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]]. The pad is situated on the starting world for the adventure which it advised can be any world in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] or [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], to be determined at the discretion of the gamemaster. The adventure specifies that this world should not be located in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] or [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and that a world situated in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] would be an especially suitable location. In ''Tempest Feud'' the player characters are tasked by Popara with a mission to Endregaad and collect from landing bay X14 the TL-1200 transport assigned for the mission.<ref name="Tempest Feud">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref>
 
The landing bay subsequently appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], an adaptation of ''Tempest Feud'' written by Jeff Grubb. In ''Scourge'' the landing bay is referred to as "landing pad X-13" and in one instance as "berth X-13"<ref name="Scourge" /> rather than the name used in ''Tempest Feud'', "landing bay X14."<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> ''Scourge'' depicts Zuma, Irana and Be'ray in role fulfilled by the players in ''Tempest Feud''<ref name="Scourge" /><ref name="Tempest Feud" /> and identifies the trio as the individuals assisting Popara who visit the landing bay to take possession of the TL-1200 transport.<ref name="Scourge" />
